summary.en: See and add to-dos in Reminders
summary.zh: 查看、新增「提醒事項」的待辦

text.en: Not yet: there is a maintained local server for Reminders, kept by one person; ShellBot has not checked it enough to recommend it.
text.zh: 還不能接：有一個持續維護的「提醒事項」本機伺服器，但只有一個人在維護，ShellBot 還沒驗證到可以推薦。

next.en: ShellBot will add a way once there is one it can stand behind; nothing needs doing now.
next.zh: 等有 ShellBot 信得過的接法就會加上；現在不用做什麼。
